newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers elects two new directors.
newsitem.headline: De Beers elects two new directors.

text.p: Diamond giant De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd said on Tuesday it had elected Brian Ainsley and Roy Edwards to its board at a meeting in Kimberley held earlier in the day.

De Beers said in a statement their election to the board of De Beers Centenary, which is incorporated in Switzerland, would be considered by shareholders at the firm's annual meeting in Lucerne on May 13.

Ainsley has been manager of operations of the diamond services division of De Beers' associate Anglo American Corp of South Africa Ltd since January last year. He was appointed an alternate director of Anglo in August 1996.
Edwards has been De Beers' consulting geologist since 1989 and was also appointed an alternate director of Anglo in August last year.
